8397248: C2: shared loop header prevents counted loop detection

Preserve a distinct inner backedge when exactly one backedge updates the
constant-stride induction variable tested by its exit comparison.

Add shared-header regression coverage and preserve the historical CastII
truncation regression with an additional partial-peeling scenario.
